read.thesis: Nucor Q4 CY25 EPS fell to $1.64 (adj $1.73) from $2.63 in Q3 as steel mill utilisation dropped to 82% and sheet margins compressed; Q1 2026 guided up on higher volumes and prices.

triggers.label: Steel mills ASP down 2% q/q
triggers.quote: External Average Sales Price per Ton $1,019 $1,038 -2%

triggers.label: Q1 2026 earnings up in all segments
triggers.quote: Earnings in the first quarter of 2026 are expected to increase across all three of our operating segments, with the largest increase in the steel mills segment.

triggers.label: Historically strong backlogs
triggers.quote: historically strong backlogs, and federal policies that support a vibrant domestic steel industry

guidance.quote: We expect earnings to increase in the first quarter of 2026.

red_flags.label: Q4 impairments and facility closures
red_flags.quote: charges of $21 million, or $0.08 per diluted share, related to the closure or repurposing of certain facilities
